metadata.evidence: `Pruned_Models/`: A collection of pre-pruned model weights (`.pth` files) for both EXTD and EResFD. The pruned models that are evaluated in Tables 1 and 2 of our paper are provided, i.e. each of the EXTD, EResFD Face Detectors is pruned using one of the FPGM, L1 pruning techniques, for target pruning rates equal to 10%, 20%, 30%, 40% and 50%. The naming convention we follow for the pruned models is straightforward; for instance, `ERES10_FPGM` refers to the EResFD model pruned with 10% sparsity using the FPGM technique.
metadata.reason: Describes available pretrained/pruned model checkpoints and their naming convention, key for reuse
